scope: Linux isolated workspaces, bounded Python input/output properties
episode_wall_seconds: explicit per-run option 30..3600; default 300; local repair calibration 900
deadline_scope: work admitted and each execution/HTTP call bounded by remaining deadline; supervisor cleanup and receipt persistence reported separately within elapsed time
review: F and E seek two distinct supported categories; coverage is informative and not an acceptance gate. Up to two retries per category within six critic calls. S retains self-review; I2 independent proposals. expanded-v1 uses five valid categories per family and candidate-independent seeded fixed order; E may prioritize visible AST cues, with the same fallback order.
library: empty and frozen in principal comparison
runtime_reproducibility: repair-v1 requires frozen Python userspace snapshot, exportable with all file hashes; no host /usr mount. Legacy fixture/MCP mode remains explicitly nonhermetic. Kernel and hardware outside userspace identity.
cache_scope: persistent authenticated exact pure-property checks only, opt-in and disabled in principal pilot; arbitrary candidate executions always run afresh
cpu_accounting: child cgroup quota; host process CPU reported separately; no electrical-energy claim
http_provider: same-origin preflight; llama.cpp applies template and sends exact token IDs to native completion; constrained JSON schema; declared context cap; no generation without reservation
model_sampling: configured seed + call index; shared sampling policy across arms; replayed observations deterministic, new model samples not guaranteed byte-identical
local_pilot: repair-v1 six-family result is development-only; repair-v2 uses seeded value variants for mechanism calibration, not independent bug-family confirmation; 25k token ceiling and all failures retained
repair_v2_primary_mechanism: E symbolic source-risk and CAM routing versus F fixed category order; seek two validated categories but record coverage as informative for all arms. All arms use identical finite final-case acceptance.
oracle: pcworld-reference-1 and pcworld-repair-reference-1; supervisor only, finite relation checks
scientific_sample: not frozen; select independent tasks and power from a real pilot
development_fixtures: 4 public properties; cannot stand in for 60 independent benchmark tasks
repair_policy: common-final-oracle-v1: witnessed CEGIS and at most two guarded repairs. Stop before exceeding critic-call quota. Freeze candidate and evaluate under remaining original budgets regardless of category coverage. GRADUADO_POR_SUPERVIVENCIA is an unverified candidate eligibility label, never correctness proof. Final public, retained counterexample and reserved development cases must all pass. Prior 0.5 results remain unchanged.
probe_catalog: legacy-v1 remains default; expanded-v1 selected explicitly in run manifest, order_seed=20261013 for discrimination pilot. No deliberately distractor-first control; categories can refute other defects.
